div.div: A deploy invalidates only the chunks that changed — that is the point of the split.

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe center; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 756px; height: 1px; padding-top: 509px; margin-left: 40px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: var(--dg-warn-fg);

div.div: Dev and production are two different pipelines: the dev server skips bundling, minification and tree shaking entirely. That is why "works in dev, broken in the build" is nearly always a side effect that tree shaking removed.
